name: Apple Veterans and Military Purchase Program
description: 10% discount on Apple products for verified military, veterans, and their households
fullDescription: Apple offers a 10% discount for current and veteran members of the US Military, National Guard, and Reserve. Discount also extends to immediate family members in the same household.
whatTheyOffer:
- About 10% off most Apple products, including Mac, iPad, unlocked iPhone, and Apple Watch
- Discounts on most accessories
- Same warranty and service as regular purchases
- Available to eligible family members in same household
- Annual purchase limits apply; personal use only
howToGetIt:
1. Visit Apple's Veterans and Military store online
2. Sign in with ID.me verification
3. Verify military or veteran status
4. Access exclusive discounted pricing
5. Purchase online through the Veterans and Military store
keywords: Apple, military discount, veteran discount, 10% off, Mac, MacBook, iPad, iPhone, Apple Watch, National Guard, Reserve, family discount
